qc.notes:
SERIES EXEMPTION, READ THIS FIRST: this series is a FAKE BEHIND-THE-SCENES of a film shoot. A giant, lifelike creature stands on a built film set and is revealed at the end to be a practical prop. Ignore the words "impossible anatomy" and "chimera" in your artifact_score definition FOR THAT CREATURE: it is the subject of the clip, not a defect, and it must NEVER raise artifact_score. Reserve the numeric artifact_score for UNINTENDED generation defects only: the man, his hands, his face, the crew, the floor or the set structure melting, duplicating, breaking or glitching.

THIS EPISODE IS ONE SINGLE UNCUT SHOT of about 10 seconds. The beat is written in the shot's own prompt, in the paragraph that begins "ONE CONTINUOUS". That paragraph is authoritative: pass the clip only if it performs that beat, and judge it against no other description. The ordered beats all happen inside that one take and their order never changes: the threat, the man taken completely out of sight inside the mouth, and the reveal that the creature is a prop with the man unharmed. The reveal belongs to the final seconds. A visible cut, edit or scene change is a FAIL.

THE PRODUCTION MUST BE VISIBLE. At least one clear production element, such as the blue screen wall, crew, camera operators, rigs or studio lights, must be visible in the sampled frames. Dressed set materials such as sand, rock and scattered props are EXPECTED. A clip in which no production element is visible, so that it reads as location footage, is a FAIL: the whole format depends on the viewer seeing that this is a film shoot.

THE AIR IS CLEAR. Fog, haze, smoke and atmospheric diffusion are NOT expected set elements in this format and should be recorded under issues when they fill the frame. This was measured: in the reference sample the videos that carried haze all failed.

SCALE CARRIES THIS FORMAT. The creature must be LARGE and CLOSE, filling much of the frame. A small or distant creature is a FAIL.

THE CREATURE IS ONE REAL, RECOGNISABLE ANIMAL at giant scale. THERE IS NO TRANSFORMATION IN THIS SERIES. Nothing morphs, nothing fuses. A creature that changes shape or species is a FAIL. This was measured: the model cannot fuse two bodies, and that failure is why this format was chosen.

ONE MAN ONLY. One face, two hands, five fingers each. A second copy of him anywhere is an automatic fail. His face must match the reference: Turkish man, warm olive skin, full neatly groomed black beard, thick dark eyebrows, short dark hair. A different face is an automatic fail; this is the single most important check. Crew members are expected and are NOT copies of him.

He NEVER speaks and never moves his mouth as if talking; there is no narration. A posed look into the lens is a fail; watching the creature or the crew is correct.

Studio equipment, rigging, cables, monitors and camera bodies in frame are EXPECTED and are not defects. Only subtitle bars, captions or watermark-style graphics laid over the footage count as unwanted text.

THE SOUND IS THE SET'S OWN SOUND: ambience, footsteps, the creature rig moving, studio air handling and crew movement.

THE CAMERA MOVES. A slow continuous push-in from a wide frame toward the action is CORRECT and is not a continuity defect. A hard cut is.

art_style: Vertical 9:16 photoreal behind-the-scenes footage of a real film shoot on a studio stage, filmed as ONE continuous uncut shot whose camera pushes in slowly from a wide establishing frame toward the action. One giant, lifelike creature built as a practical effect stands on a minimal dressed set: bare studio concrete around a shallow island of sand and earth with a few scattered rocks, one bare log and sparse dry grass. A tall blue screen wall with pale blue cross tracking markers rises behind it, a wide overhead grid of white diffusion softboxes lights the stage, and crew in dark clothing, camera rigs on a dolly track and cables make the production obvious. The air is clear. Natural colour, true skin tones and real depth of field; everything else obeys ordinary physics.

characters.name: Ihsan
characters.bio: Kanalin yuzu, Ihsan'in kendi figuru. Her bolumde bir film setinde dev, gercekci bir yaratikla sahneye cikar; yaratik onu agzina alir, ekip cenesini acar, o yara almadan cikar. Kamerada ASLA konusmaz ve agzini konusur gibi oynatmaz; bu seride anlatim ve muzik YOKTUR, ses setin kendi sesidir. Yuzu ve govdesi kadrajda NET gorunur, kameraya degil yaratiga ya da ekibe bakar. Kiyafeti bolumden bolume SETE GORE degisir; degismeyen sey adamin KENDISIDIR.
characters.appearance: A 30-year-old Turkish man with warm olive skin, dark brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, and a full, neatly groomed black beard and moustache. Short dark brown-black hair. Athletic lean-muscular build with broad shoulders, visibly fit. His expression is alarm and disbelief: eyes wide, mouth slightly open, body tensed or already turning away. He is dressed appropriately for the location of the episode, in practical outdoor clothing that fits that environment. No visible tattoos, no watch, no jewellery. Hands anatomically correct: exactly two hands, five fingers each. Realistic, grounded, handheld-camera look.

The air is clear.

The air is clear.

A minimal built desert set inside a film studio: bare studio concrete around a shallow island of pale sand with a few broken sandstone blocks, one bare log and sparse dry grass, a tall blue screen wall with pale blue cross tracking markers rising behind it, and a wide overhead grid of white diffusion softboxes lighting the stage. The air is clear.
